remote.cohort_rule: Three latest successful main CI/C++ pairs plus three successful pairs from distinct representative PR branches with identical actual-checkout workflow/configuration/lock inputs.
limits: Historical successful-run timing baseline, not fresh current-commit validation evidence.
API head_sha identifies branch source. PR runs checked out synthetic merge commits, separately recorded.

C++ checkout used a REST archive before Git was installed. Its log contains a 7-character resolved-version prefix, not git log proof; full SHA resolution and source inspection are separately recorded.

All actual checkout commits have identical workflow/configuration/lock inputs, but code and passing-test counts differ (5120-5158). These are comparable configuration cohorts, not identical-head repeated measurements.
Only successful attempts were selected. This cohort does not quantify failed-run cost, cold-cache cost, manual workflows, or formal GPU execution.
Wall-clock uses last jobs.completed_at minus run.created_at, not mutable run.updated_at. Step and job API timestamps have second resolution.
gh flattened older logs label steps UNKNOWN STEP; exact API job and step data supply duration names.
Per-quantity medians are not additive and must not be summed into a median workflow total.
Restored ccache counters are cumulative; displayed counters do not establish per-run hit ratios.
Native configure/build split is approximate from step start to Build files have been written marker and from that marker to step end.
No validation coverage, required checks, trust, routing, cache design, or execution substrate was changed.

regeneration.note: Original collection used the run /jobs endpoint; every collected run is attempt 1. Regeneration fixes the attempt endpoint. Decode contents-API base64 content before computing SHA256; retain API sha as the Git blob ID.

build/saccade_tracking_ext.cpython-312-x.provenance: The SHA-256 proves the loaded bytes equal the measured ones; it does not prove which source revision built them. The file was not rebuilt for 83c9bef0 (its mtime predates that commit) and no source-to-binary attestation was made.
